methodology.heading: Methodology
methodology.snippet: BACK TO INDEX Methodology This public beta is designed to help general readers understand how exposed different occupations may be to current AI tools. It is a directional reference, not a prediction engine. FROZEN PUBLIC BETA DATASET V1 LAST UPDATED MARCH 16, 2026 WHAT THIS INDEX DOES It compares occupations on a shared scale, overlays approximate salary data, maps each role to an automation timeline band, and now shows task-level AI capability assessments inside the detail view. WHAT IT DOES NOT DO It does not forecast layoffs, career outcomes, labour demand, or policy decisions. It also does not measure the social value of human care, trust, or physical presence beyond the score framework. TASK-LEVEL ASSESSMENT MODEL For occupations with an OSCA Main Tasks list, the app splits the official task string on semicolons and evaluates each task against a March 2026 AI capability map. Each task is marked as yes, partial, or no, then assigned to one capability bucket with example tools. Occupations without a task list fall back to the OSCA lead statement.
